description: This file defines the ConsoleInputCollector class, which implements InputCollectorInterface to collect input values for recipes from the command line in Drupal. It manages command-line options, retrieves input values, and interacts with Symfony Console components.

classes.name: ConsoleInputCollector
classes.description: Final class implementing InputCollectorInterface to gather command line input for recipes, supporting the '--input' option and prompting user input.

methods.name: configureCommand
methods.description: Configures a Symfony Console Command to support the '--input' option with description and array value.

methods.name: getInputFromOptions
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the '--input' options passed to the command, returning an associative array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: collectValue
methods.description: Collects a value for a given recipe input, either from command line options or by prompting the user based on the DataDefinitionInterface settings.
